summary: RBizz is a Melbourne CA/CPA-led firm led by Raj Kumar, offering virtual CFO, tax, accounting and foreign business services from a team of 12. Raj publishes regularly on Virtual CFO work and has a corporate group-consolidation background. Two earlier emails have been sent.

sources.title: You Don't Need a Full-Time CFO. You Need Someone Doing the CFO's Job.

claims.text: RBizz Corporate Accountants is headquartered at Level 27, 101 Collins St, Melbourne, with offices in Sydney, Perth, Brisbane and Narre Warren.
claims.quote: Headquartered on Collins Street in Melbourne, with a footprint across Australia's major business centres.

claims.text: Raj Kumar is Principal of RBizz Corporate Accountants, current since April 2019.
claims.quote: Principal @ RBizz Corporate Accountants | CA, CPA

claims.text: RBizz describes a team of 12 Chartered Accountants, CPAs and bookkeepers plus systems and administration specialists.
claims.quote: Raj is supported by a 12-strong team of Chartered Accountants, CPAs and bookkeepers

claims.text: Raj posted in July 2026 that RBizz's Virtual CFO service includes monthly management accounts and board packs.
claims.quote: Monthly management accounts and board packs

claims.text: RBizz published a blog on 4 November 2026 arguing growing businesses need CFO work such as forecasting and cash flow modelling rather than just up-to-date accounting.
claims.quote: the accounting is up to date but the big questions are still unanswered

claims.text: RBizz sets up and trains clients on cloud accounting across Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, Reckon and Zoho Books.
claims.quote: Cloud accounting, reporting, bookkeeping set-up and training across Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, Reckon and Zoho Books.

claims.text: RBizz offers foreign business services including company formation in Australia and foreign subsidiary set-up and management.
Raj's LinkedIn says he prepared consolidated financial statements for up to 20 group companies and led ERP adoption in four international firms.
claims.quote: Enhanced and prepared consolidated financial statements for up to 20 group companies.

claims.text: RBizz positions itself as a partnership between professional expertise and AI technologies.
claims.quote: a perfect partnership between professional expertise and AI technologies

hooks.text: Raj's July 2026 post on monthly management accounts and board packs - reconciliation is the step that gates them
Foreign-owned entity clients and Raj's group consolidation background suggest multi-entity close load

risks.text: RBizz describes itself as combining professional expertise with AI technologies, so it may already use AI tooling
Two earlier emails already sent (16 and 23 Nov); keep follow-ups short and new-angle

gaps: Which AI tools RBizz uses is not stated
